approved: Social Services and Other Legislation Amendment (2014 Budget Measures No. 6) Bill 2014
Social Services and Other Legislation Amendment (2014 Budget Measures No. 6) Bill 2014 - Second Reading - Agree with the main idea of the bill

Argued that Labor had blocked government cuts of up to $80 a week to pensions affecting 3.7 million pensioners, including protecting 700000 single-income families from losing family tax benefit B and stopping the pension eligibility age rising to 70, but criticised a deal with the Greens to scrap the seniors supplement worth $886.60 a year for singles.

Argued that the Social Services and Other Legislation Amendment (2014 Budget Measures No. 6) Bill 2014 would deliver $2.7 billion in budget savings through changes to supplements, indexation, portability periods, disability support assessments, student assistance, the Commonwealth seniors health card and family payments.
